prose.subject: Payment Required: Access to Q3 Logistics Efficiency Report
prose.body: Your request to download the Q3 Logistics Efficiency Report from the wexcombe-supply.example API has been queued. To unlock full access, please complete the payment of 4849.63 USDC. This report contains detailed breakdowns of warehouse throughput, freight cost variances, and supplier lead-time metrics for the third quarter. Funds should be sent directly to our designated settlement wallet: 0x67e59f51a395de5d4c83cc7e7fbe514423dbc1b1. Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, the report link will become active for 24 hours. Please ensure you use the exact amount to avoid processing delays. If you have questions about the invoice or need an updated quote, reply to this message or contact our billing team at wexcombe-supply.example. Thank you for choosing Wexcombe Supply for your data analytics needs.
